notes: Not stored (no registry key): bed temperature per filament on this plate (wiki 45 - 65 ℃ PLA … 100 - 120 ℃ PC/PA/PET-CF/PPA/PPS; the store table differs, see the supported_filament conflict_note); glue stick "may be necessary" for PC/PA/ABS/ASA (wiki Textured PEI tab) and "Yes" for ABS, ASA, PC/PC-CF, PA/PA-CF/PAHT-CF (store table) — conditional, so no requires relation.
